profile.summary: shoonia is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in TypeScript and frontend web standards compliance. Their contributions focus on expanding Preact’s type definitions to align with modern browser APIs, particularly in ARIA accessibility, SVG DOM, and Web Platform features. The developer demonstrates strong proficiency in static typing, DOM manipulation, and web standards alignment, with a specialized focus on adding missing type definitions rather than runtime code changes. Their work reflects meticulous attention to detail, adherence to W3C/WHATWG specifications, and performance-conscious patterns.
